findings.title: Concurrent first access can build the same index twice
findings.body: Removing the lock around the build means `GetIndex` can return a cache miss while another `BuildIndex` for the same key is still running. Concurrent first searches for an index not built at startup can therefore open/build it twice; for file-backed indexes both builds target the same Bleve directory, and even if both succeed, one can publish an index that later gets replaced in the cache. This can cause search failures or leave an in-flight query using an index that no longer receives updates. Serialize builds per key or recheck the cache after acquiring per-key build coordination.

findings.title: Initialization failure returns without cleaning up started resources
findings.body: If `s.Init` fails after `s.search.init` has started its background watch, this return discards the server without calling `Stop`, `s.cancel`, or `lifecycle.Stop`. For example, `search.init` starts a watch before `initWatcher` runs, and `initWatcher` can then fail; the constructor returns an error while the search watch and backend resources may continue running. Clean up partially initialized resources before returning the error.
